_note: Frozen cut-offs for the Jev comparison, kept with questions.json (article 2). Set on validation only; `jev.py freeze` records the date and question hashes and unseals the final sets. Never edit after freezing.
good_rule: p_good = P(relevant=2) x P(real=2) x P(useful>=1); good if p_good >= 0.5. The most-probable-level rule is reported alongside.
coverage_threshold_note: Chosen on validation from the coverage-against-agreement curve, then applied once to final.
